elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code creating a multiple linear regression model using features ['BARTHAG', 'WAB', 'TOR'] to predict response variable 'W'. Code includes model fitting, extracting intercept and coefficients, printing rounded results, and model score. Output shown: Intercept: 16.116, Coefficients: [4.502, 0.526, -0.169], Score: 0.59.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to create and evaluate a multiple linear regression model in Python using three features to predict a response variable, showing the intercept, coefficients, and model score.
